notes.title: Sorry! Fixed
notes.notes:
We owe you all a big apology for the recent mess caused by our latest patch. It wasn't our finest moment, and we're sorry for any frustration it may have caused. 

We're happy to announce that the issues have been resolved! The game is back on track, and we can't wait for you to check it out. 

If, by any chance, you still come across any hiccups or glitches, don't sweat it! We're all ears and ready to tackle any problems head-on. Just give us a shout, and we'll jump right into action to make things right.

Thanks a million for sticking with us during this bumpy ride. We genuinely appreciate your support and patience. Now, let's dive back into the game and have a blast together!❤️
